notes.title: Major Update Released! Conquer the High-Difficulty Sauna Dungeon.
notes.content:
A major update has been released!

Thank you for your patience.
We’ve added the high-difficulty dungeon Sauna Building: Fairytale and two new skills.

[h3]High-Difficulty Dungeon[/h3]

This is an extremely challenging dungeon where you start with no level and no sauna items.
Can you liberate the sauna Fairytale that has been taken over by the Dark Heat Master? Challenge yourself!
Unlocking facilities inside the building will give you an advantage in your quest.

The high-difficulty dungeon Sauna Building: Fairytale unlocks after playing Endless Summer.

[previewyoutube=c0PKgqqAUho;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Skills[/h3]

[b]Scorching Aufguss[/b]
A skill that delivers a scorching Aufguss across a wide area.
It can be activated by adding firewood to the sauna stove. You can store up to 3 charges and activate them at any time.

[previewyoutube=WkjUz8TmchI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











[b]Wind Ring[/b]
A skill that surrounds your body with wind and targets nearby sauna-goers.
It can be activated through Loyly. You can store up to 3 charges and activate them at any time.

[previewyoutube=wHRwJWk4I0o;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










We’ve also added powerful effects to Loyly and firewood.
Enjoy the special actions that take place in the sauna.
Please give it a try!

We welcome your feedback!
Thank you for your continued support of Sauna of the DEAD.

tags.feature: We’ve added the high-difficulty dungeon Sauna Building: Fairytale and two new skills.
Scorching Aufguss
Wind Ring
We’ve also added powerful effects to Loyly and firewood.

notes.title: Exciting announcement about a major update.
notes.content:
I have an exciting announcement about a major update.
We are currently developing a new game mode.
In this mode, you will liberate the Fairy Tale sauna building that has been ravaged by the Dark Heat Master.
Expect a very challenging gameplay experience as this new mode will be unforgiving and intense.

Additionally, we plan to introduce new skills to complement the new game mode.

Scorching Heat Wave Aufguss
[previewyoutube=WkjUz8TmchI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Hot Wind Armor
[previewyoutube=SN4Jul_9nx8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
We are currently balancing this new game mode.
After adjustments, we will update the Early Access version.
Following feedback and improvements, we will transition to the full release.

Thank you for your continued support of Sauna of the DEAD.

notes.title: Early Access version 0.4.22 is now available.
notes.content:
Early Access version 0.4.22 is now available.

I fixed a bug where the save data location was incorrect.

If you have been playing since before version 0.4.21, the following information is not necessary.
*If you started the game from version 0.4.21, please either start over or follow the steps below to move your save data.

1. Back up both the correct and incorrect folders finger-tip/SaunaOfTheDEAD and finger-tip/Sauna of the DEAD according to your Win/Mac environment.
2. Copy the 2751820 and 2780140 folders from the finger-tip/SaunaOfTheDEAD folder.
3. Paste them into the finger-tip/Sauna of the DEAD folder.

Save data locations for Windows:
Correct location:
C:/Users/[yourname]/AppData/LocalLow/finger-tip/Sauna of the DEAD
Incorrect location:
C:/Users/[yourname]/AppData/LocalLow/finger-tip/SaunaOfTheDEAD

Save data locations for Mac:
Correct location:
/Users/[yourname]/Library/Application Support/finger-tip/Sauna of the DEAD
Incorrect location:
/Users/[yourname]/Library/Application Support/finger-tip/SaunaOfTheDEAD

I apologize for the inconvenience.
If you have any trouble with the above process, please post on the forum.
I will support you as much as possible.

tags.bug: I fixed a bug where the save data location was incorrect.
